annotations.text:
KetoClub — Fresh Market, built out.

Every screen carries a Light/Dark tweak above the artboard, so any of them flips. "Restaurant menu — dark" is the same screen set to Dark, and Settings' own Appearance control drives its screen live.

The traffic lights are no longer a dot: each dish gets a coloured left rail, a labelled status pill, a tinted card and a matching net-carb chip. The three counters under the venue name are the filter — tap one.
Photo tiles are placeholders — real imagery comes from the Wolt/10bis feeds at runtime.
